name: QueryPilot Phase-9 Regression Benchmark
purpose: Phase-9 development, profiling, optimization, and regression testing.

records.question: What are the names of pilots between the ages of 30 and 40, ordered by age ascending?
records.gold_sql: SELECT pilot_name FROM pilotskills WHERE age BETWEEN 30 AND 40 ORDER BY age

records.question: What are the average and smallest ages of all pilots?
records.gold_sql: SELECT avg(age) ,  min(age) FROM pilotskills

records.question: Find the number of all distinct contents in all the boxes.
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT CONTENTS) FROM boxes

records.question: Find the code of boxes that are stored at the warehouses located at Chicago or New York.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.code FROM boxes AS T1 JOIN warehouses AS T2 ON T1.warehouse  =  T2.code WHERE T2.location  =  'Chicago' OR T2.location  =  'New York'

records.question: What are the titles of books that are not "Poet"?
records.gold_sql: SELECT Title FROM book WHERE TYPE != "Poet"

records.question: What are the types of books that have at least three books belonging to?
records.gold_sql: SELECT TYPE FROM book GROUP BY TYPE HAVING COUNT(*)  >=  3

records.question: What are the names of drivers, ordered descending alphabetically?
records.gold_sql: SELECT Driver_Name FROM driver ORDER BY Driver_Name DESC

records.question: Find the names of drivers who were in both "James Hinchcliffe" and "Carl Skerlong" pole positions before.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Driver_Name FROM driver AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.Driver_ID  =  T2.Driver_ID WHERE Pole_Position  =  "Carl Skerlong" INTERSECT SELECT T1.Driver_Name FROM driver AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.Driver_ID  =  T2.Driver_ID WHERE Pole_Position  =  "James Hinchcliffe"

records.question: Find the id of Sailors (sid) that reserved red or blue boat.
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.sid FROM Boats AS T1 JOIN Reserves AS T2 ON  T1.bid  =  T2.bid WHERE T1.color  =  'red' OR T1.color  =  "blue"

records.question: What are the names and ids of sailors who reserved red and blue boats?
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.sid ,  T3.name FROM Boats AS T1 JOIN Reserves AS T2 ON  T1.bid  =  T2.bid JOIN Sailors AS T3 ON T2.sid  =  T3.sid WHERE T1.color  =  'red' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT T2.sid ,  T3.name FROM Boats AS T1 JOIN Reserves AS T2 ON  T1.bid  =  T2.bid JOIN Sailors AS T3 ON T2.sid  =  T3.sid WHERE T1.color  =  "blue"

records.question: What are the names of the countries, ordered descending by overall score?
records.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM countries ORDER BY overall_score DESC

records.question: Show the official languages sorted in descending order by the average overall scores among countries speaking them.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T3.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN official_languages AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.country_id JOIN languages AS T3 ON T2.language_id  =  T3.id GROUP BY T3.id ORDER BY avg(T1.overall_score) DESC

records.question: Show different nationalities of customers, along with the number of customers of each nationality.
records.gold_sql: SELECT Nationality ,  COUNT(*) FROM customer GROUP BY Nationality

records.question: List the names of customers that do not have any order.
records.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customer WHERE Customer_ID NOT IN (SELECT Customer_ID FROM customer_order)

records.question: How many drivers have driven vehicles built in 2012?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT T1.driver_id) FROM vehicle_driver AS T1 JOIN vehicle AS T2 ON T1.vehicle_id  =  T2.vehicle_id WHERE T2.build_year  =  2012

records.question: Count the number of different drivers who have driven vehicles built in 2012.
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT T1.driver_id) FROM vehicle_driver AS T1 JOIN vehicle AS T2 ON T1.vehicle_id  =  T2.vehicle_id WHERE T2.build_year  =  2012

records.question: Find all spokesman's names and speech titles.
records.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  speach_title FROM spokesman

records.question: Find the total and average population of the districts which have some spokesman.
records.gold_sql: SELECT sum(population) ,  avg(population) FROM district WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM spokesman_district)

records.question: What is the first name and age of the artist who lived the longest?
records.gold_sql: SELECT fname  ,  deathYear - birthYear FROM artists ORDER BY deathYear - birthYear DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What are the first and last names of the artists who did not sculpt but could paint.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.lname ,  T1.fname FROM artists AS T1 JOIN paintings AS T2 ON T1.artistID  =  T2.painterID EXCEPT SELECT T3.lname ,  T3.fname FROM artists AS T3 JOIN sculptures AS T4 ON T3.artistID  =  T4.sculptorID

records.question: What is the total number of conferences?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM conference

records.question: What are the names of all the conferences that has staff from Canada attending?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.conference_name FROM conference AS T1 JOIN conference_participation AS T2 ON T1.conference_id = T2.conference_id JOIN staff AS T3 ON T2.staff_id  =  T3.staff_id WHERE T3.nationality  =  "Canada"

records.question: How many universities are in Illinois or Ohio?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM University WHERE state  =  'Illinois' OR state  =  'Ohio'

records.question: What is the name and overall ranking of universities in Wisconsin state?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.university_name ,  T2.rank FROM University AS T1 JOIN Overall_ranking AS T2 ON T1.university_id  =  T2.university_id WHERE T1.state  =  'Wisconsin'

records.question: Show the name, age, membership credit for all customers?
records.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  age ,  membership_credit FROM customers

records.question: What are the average city fuel economy rate, average highway fuel economy rate for different types of powertrains?
records.gold_sql: SELECT avg(City_fuel_economy_rate) ,  avg(Highway_fuel_economy_rate) , Type_of_powertrain FROM vehicles GROUP BY Type_of_powertrain

records.question: Give the id and name of the cheapest Hardware product.
records.gold_sql: SELECT product_id ,  product_name FROM Products WHERE product_type_code  =  "Hardware" ORDER BY product_price ASC LIMIT 1

records.question: What are the order ids and corresponding order dates for orders with a quantity greater than 6 or consisting of more than 3 products?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.order_date ,  T1.order_id FROM Customer_Orders AS T1 JOIN Order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id  =  T2.order_id WHERE T2.order_quantity  >  6 UNION SELECT T1.order_date ,  T1.order_id FROM Customer_Orders AS T1 JOIN Order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id  =  T2.order_id GROUP BY T1.order_id HAVING count(*)  >  3;

records.question: What are the ids and titles for papers that have never been cited?
records.gold_sql: SELECT paper_id ,  title FROM Paper WHERE paper_id NOT IN (SELECT cited_paper_id FROM Citation)

records.question: What is the name of the affiliation which publishes the greatest number of papers among those whose address contains 'China'.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM Affiliation AS T1 JOIN Author_list AS T2 ON T1.affiliation_id  =  T2.affiliation_id WHERE T1.address LIKE "%China%" GROUP BY T1.affiliation_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: List the dates of all shipments.
records.gold_sql: SELECT Date FROM Shipment;

records.question: List the manger's name and number of shipments under his management.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name ,  count(*) FROM Shipment AS T1 JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.Manager = T2.EmployeeID GROUP BY T1.Manager;

records.question: Find all the layer type codes with their corresponding usage count.
records.gold_sql: SELECT analytical_layer_type_code ,  count(*) FROM analytical_layer GROUP BY analytical_layer_type_code

records.question: Which services have been rated as "unsatisfied" in customers and services details? Give me the service_details.
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.service_details FROM services AS t1 JOIN customers_and_services AS t2 ON t1.service_id  =  t2.service_id WHERE t2.customers_and_services_details  =  "Unsatisfied"

records.question: For each question type, return its type code and its count of occurrence.
records.gold_sql: SELECT Type_of_Question_Code ,  COUNT(*) FROM Questions GROUP BY Type_of_Question_Code

records.question: List all the distinct student answer texts to which comments "Normal" were given?
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Student_Answer_Text FROM Student_Answers WHERE Comments  =  "Normal"

records.question: List the codes and descriptions for all staff roles.
records.gold_sql: SELECT staff_role_code ,  staff_role_description FROM Ref_staff_roles

records.question: How many staff are the document with id 0 and process with id 9.
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Staff_in_processes WHERE document_id  =  0 AND process_id  =  9

records.question: What is the biographical information of the students who got the most common result for their behaviour monitoring details ?
records.gold_sql: select t1.bio_data from students as t1 join behaviour_monitoring as t2 on t1.student_id  =  t2.student_id where t2.behaviour_monitoring_details in ( select behaviour_monitoring_details from behaviour_monitoring group by behaviour_monitoring_details order by count(*) desc limit 1 ) except select t1.bio_data from students as t1 join behaviour_monitoring as t2 on t1.student_id  =  t2.student_id where t2.behaviour_monitoring_details not in ( select behaviour_monitoring_details from behaviour_monitoring group by behaviour_monitoring_details order by count(*) desc limit 1 )

records.question: How many students have gone through a detention?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT student_id) FROM Detention
